title: Kneser- and Jin-type inverse theorems in discrete abelian groups
summary: We characterize the pairs of sets $A, B$ in an arbitrary (countable or uncountable) discrete abelian group $Γ$ satisfying $\tilde{m}(A+B)<\tilde{m}(A)+\tilde{m}(B)$, where $\tilde{m}$ is an arbitrary finitely additive translation-invariant probability measure on $Γ$, extending M.~Kneser's theorem on Haar measure in compact abelian groups.
